title: Check against a checklist
summary: Check a text against each item of a checklist.

inputs.text: Applications close on 30 June. Contact Mei Lin with questions.
inputs.checklist: ["States the deadline","Names a contact person","Mentions the budget"]

sections.use: Review a draft against your checklist, item by item, with a quote as evidence for each.
sections.exclusions: It does not edit the text; use rewrite_for_audience or proofread for that.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 32,768 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 4,096 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Text up to 20,000 characters; 1 to 20 checklist items. Items are echoed exactly and in order, and evidence should be verbatim; the evaluation checks this.
sections.missing_data: Without supporting text, evidence is empty and met is no or unclear.
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.

inputs.checklist: The checklist items, a JSON list of 1 to 20 strings.

outputs.results: One result per item: item, met (yes, no or unclear) and evidence.
